documents.title: Poinsett County 2026 budget, as filed with the state
documents.note: Posted on the Arkansas Transparency portal (artransparency.gov) in May 2026. 144 pages. Amounts are the 'Original Budget' / 'Adj. Budget' in the Budget Detail Report (pp. 42-130); identical on every row and equal to the ordinance's '2026 Projected Expenditures' for every department and fund column. The document is a scan; it was read with optical character recognition, and every parent total was checked against its parts.
